item.title: ‘She’ll never be gone’: Memorial held for fallen WSP Trooper Tara-Marysa Guting
item.description: Family, friends and colleagues described Trooper Tara-Marysa Guting as someone who had a smile that would brighten the room and said her presence was a gift.

item.title: Seattle weather: Dry streak continues with chilly workweek start
item.description: The Puget Sound region finally sees a day without NWS weather alerts! A cool, drying pattern will continue into the workweek.

item.title: Seattle Seahawks close in on NFC's top seed with 27-10 win over Panthers
item.description: Zach Charbonnet ran for 110 yards and two touchdowns, and the Seattle Seahawks beat the Carolina Panthers 27-10 on Sunday and close in on the No. 1 seed in the NFC playoffs.

item.title: Washington State Ferries begin winter schedules, additional routes adjusted
item.description: Ferries across Puget Sound will now take on their annual shift to winter schedules following the Christmas holiday week. There are several lines with changes this season.

item.title: Family of woman last seen in Auburn, WA asks public for answers
item.description: Detectives continue trying to "sift through lore" surrounding cold cases like this missing 21-year-old out of Auburn. Her family hopes the public can help find her.

item.title: Takeaways from Seattle Seahawks 27-10 win over Panthers
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks are one win away from an NFC West title and homefield advantage in the playoffs after a 27-10 victory over the Carolina Panthers on Sunday.

item.title: Seattle Weather: Cold and Dry to Start the Week
item.description: Cool and dry the next few days with a chance of showers by New Year's Day.

item.title: Casey O'Brien's hat trick sinks Seattle Torrent in 4-3 loss to Sirens
item.description: Casey O'Brien scored the game-winning goal for the New York Sirens with 3:20 left to play to complete a hat trick in a 4-3 victory over the Seattle Torrent in Dallas on Sunday night.

item.title: Philipp Grubauer saves 31, Eeli Tolvanen scores twice as Seattle Kraken beat Flyers 4-1
item.description: Philipp Grubauer stopped 31 shots, Eeli Tolvanen scored twice in the third period, and the Seattle Kraken defeated the Philadelphia Flyers 4-1 on Sunday night.

item.title: Seattle Seahawks and San Francisco 49ers Week 18 matchup scheduled for Saturday night
item.description: The battle for the NFC West title and the No. 1 seed in the NFC between the Seattle Seahawks and San Francisco 49ers will be at 5 p.m. on Saturday night, the NFL announced.
